articles.title: From Fort Sill to the world: Red Cross Hero Care Center keeps military families connected
articles.summary: When a military family faces an emergency, distance shouldn't stand in the way of getting help. For more than 27 years, the American Red Cross Hero Care Center at Fort Sill has served as a lifeline, connecting service members around the world with loved ones during life's most difficult moments. articles.title: Montana National Guard Connects Educators with Opportunities at Youth Challenge Academy
articles.summary: DILLON, Mont. — The Montana National Guard partnered with the Montana Youth Challenge Academy (MYCA) and the University of Montana Western to bring educators from across the state to Dillon, Oct. 21, for a firsthand look at a program helping young Montanans build brighter futures.

articles.title: The Beast meets the Bats: Iowa Airmen welcome Secret Service
articles.summary: Iowa Air National Guard Airmen assigned to the 185th Air Refueling Wing welcomed U.S. Secret Service personnel prior to a presidential visit to Sioux City, Iowa, Oct. 22, 2026.

articles.title: Garrison welcomes new senior enlisted advisor
articles.summary: FORT HOOD, Texas — U.S. Army Garrison-Fort Hood held a change of responsibility Friday at III Armored Corps Headquarters, passing responsibility from Command Sgt. Maj. Loyd Rhoades to Command Sgt. Maj. Kristopher Tate.
